in_marathi.name: Akki
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Little one, sister
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akki हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Akki is a diminutive form of the name Akka, which means 'sister' in the Sanskrit and Hindi languages. It is a term of endearment used to address a younger sister or a close female friend. The name Akki is also associated with the sun god and the goddess of water, symbolizing the warmth and nurturing qualities of these deities.
